about: Chapter 12 (family farmer and fisherman) bankruptcy cases commenced in each 12-month period, by federal court district, from U.S. Courts Table F-2. A state with more than one district is the sum of its districts. Filings, not farms. 12-month totals only. Built by scripts/build_chapter12.py; every period's districts add up to the table's own Total row.
